messages.text: I turned on reduced motion on my computer, but the cards and the win banner still animate. Could you fix that and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Fixed cards and the win banner to respect reduced motion, including setting changes during play. Normal animations remain intact.

Build/typecheck, 138 unit tests, and 76 browser checks passed, including both motion tests. One face-sheet screenshot test timed out twice. Formatting passes for the changed CSS; three untouched test files have existing formatting issues.
